mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_log (order_id, order_no, pay_channel, pay_status, transaction_no, amount) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{payChannel}, #{payStatus}, #{transactionNo}, #{amount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_no, pay_channel, pay_status, transaction_no, amount, created_at, callback_at FROM payment_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
